Each sentence is a list of words drawn from a tiny four-word vocabulary. We
ADDED i2: A {@link CommandVisitor} that replays an edit script against a working copy of the source list, transforming it into the target list as commands are visited. {@

ADDED i6: @return the current working sequence with all elements concatenated
ADDED i7: The four-word Shadok vocabulary used to build sentences.

ADDED i9: Builds every possible sentence (word list) whose length ranges from 0 up to {@link #MAX_SENTENCE_LENGTH} - 1, using words from {@link #SHADOK_VOCABULARY}. @retu
ADDED i10: The empty sentence is always present.
ADDED i11: Extend every sentence from the previous generation by one word.
ADDED i12: Concatenates the words of a sentence into a single string, mirroring how the {@link ExecutionVisitor} accumulates the words it visits. @param sentence the sente
ADDED i13: Replay the edit script (source -> target) starting from source.
ADDED i14: The replayed script must rebuild the target sentence exactly.
